fixed.explanation: gitDiff always passes --depth=1 when fetching the PR base commit. On a complete clone this turns the repository shallow. The fix checks `git rev-parse --is-shallow-repository` and adds --depth=1 only when the repo is already shallow. A full clone then fetches the base commit without cutting history.

query.intent: The git info plugin in the test runner, when capturing a diff on CI, runs a git fetch of the pull request base commit with --depth=1 into the user's repository. This must avoid making a full clone shallow, by omitting the depth option when the repo is not shallow or by fetching without modifying the repo.
query.symptom: Collecting git diff info on CI runs `git fetch --depth=1` of the base commit, turning a complete clone into a shallow clone and corrupting history for later steps.
